note: Arms of the pre-registered beta.3 phase 2 experiment (E2). Every arm uses the shipped training.json mix and settings (open x2, MASC, silver >= 80, imperative, compound and compound2 at weight 1; headings, headings2 and the four technical sources at weight 0) with --features clauseCues and --calibrate; only the weights of the four technical sources and the seed differ. A source of an arm is trained at the weight given here with the option --source NAME:WEIGHT, which the driver appends after --calibrate --output; BASE has none (it is exactly the shipped training.json). The arms run in file order, BASE first, one driver invocation per arm. TECH-NT is for attribution only and cannot win (role attribution).
